title: Clarify Joseph copper-patina phase evidence and quantitative definitions
body:
## Source gap

Clarify the original phase evidence and quantitative definitions in [Joseph et al. 2012](https://doi.org/10.3389/fmicb.2011.00270) before extending the brochantite or atacamite records beyond their qualified laboratory observations. These are unresolved source questions, not a finding that the currently bounded records are invalid.

The complete eight-page 2012 original, all eight figures and Table 1 were inspected. The record preserves the incorrect brochantite formula, compound-versus-copper loading ambiguity, the dry-mycelium versus dried-culture product denominator, separate acid assay, atacamite growth inhibition and limited controls. No recovery efficiency or oxalate production rate is imported.

The related characterization article, [Joseph et al. 2011](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00216-010-4279-2), is explicitly referenced by the 2012 paper. Publisher and Bologna routes exposed metadata/abstracts; a public author PDF request returned 403. Parsed article text was accessible but screenshot calls did not return images. The exact Neuchatel repository item `a109f113-6a89-478e-b887-efa452bc2eaf` returned an empty public bundles list. These bounded results do not prove global unavailability; its original graphics have not been accepted as directly inspected evidence.

## Acceptance checks

1. Acquire the complete 2011 original and relevant supplements from a legitimate publisher, institutional or author route. Retain URL, version, terms, acquisition time and SHA256; inspect the original figures and tables.
2. Map each pattern and sample to synthetic brochantite, synthetic atacamite or a mixed corrosion coupon. Distinguish shared experiments across publications from independent replication.
3. Resolve Figure 1 loading units and the product-estimate denominator in the 2012 paper using original data, a documented correction or an explicit author clarification. Do not convert dry-product fractions to recovery yields without an inventory balance.
4. Resolve the oxalate assay's reported rate units and extrapolated mass relative to the feed. Preserve uncertainty rather than silently correcting values.
5. Update maintained records only for newly supported claims, with canonical EDIT history and independent reviews of the final bytes. Retain the present uncertainty if source access or clarification remains unavailable.

See `research/sources/round84-copper-patinas/20261015T000916Z-source-investigation.{md,json}` for the complete bounded acquisition and deduplication trail. Original PDFs remain outside Git.
disposition: Open source follow-up; current scoped evidence retained. No claim of resolved source uncertainty.

title: Acquire the full silica-sand Shewanella journal study and clarify thesis assay provenance
body:
## Source gap

Acquire the complete journal original for **Yahaya et al., “Bioleaching of silica sand using bioreducing bacteria (Shewanella strains)”**, DOI [10.4314/bajopas.v11i1.16s](https://doi.org/10.4314/bajopas.v11i1.16s), and clarify its relationship to the [official Newcastle thesis](https://theses.ncl.ac.uk/jspui/handle/10443/1346). The issue is a source follow-up, not a claim that the accepted narrow silica-sand assay is invalid.

The complete 297-page deposited thesis is available and has been inspected for the accepted Chapter 2/5 microcosm claims, but visibly retains tracked changes, editorial questions and overlapping numbering. The record keeps two quarry feeds separate and measures HCl-extractable slurry Fe(II), not dissolved-only iron or isolated recovery. The journal abstract's 17.6% / 117 mg Fe2O3 per 100 g result is excluded pending its original methods, figures and denominator.

## Acquisition and unresolved questions

- Official AJOL landing: https://www.ajol.info/index.php/bajopas/article/view/182923 — direct public retrieval returned HTTP 202 with an empty body; indexed abstract was readable. A guessed download suffix failed and is not treated as a verified file route.
- HAL record https://hal.science/hal-03210470v1 — its public search API resolved the exact normalized DOI/title but returned no `fileMain_s`; no downloadable original was supplied by that response.
- Crossref resolves the DOI, an issue labelled 2018 and online publication 2019-02-07. These dates must not be silently conflated.
- Official thesis PDF https://theses.ncl.ac.uk/jspui/bitstream/10443/1346/1/Yahaya12.pdf — SHA256 `5360dc03aad9fc7cd38b340e43fad45f4c01ecb7da433ac00fe455646d9d61e5`; repository year 2012, cover/declaration September 2011. The inspected item page did not identify a clean replacement version.

The source also leaves ambiguous which cell-free versus cell-and-donor-free blank belongs to each silica figure; Figure 5.4's caption names Sand 2 while its discussion concerns Sand 3. These ambiguities must not be resolved by guessing.

## Acceptance checks

1. Obtain full journal text, all original figures/tables and any supplements through a legitimate publisher/repository route; record actual URLs, status, version, licence and hashes.
2. Map each journal assay to the thesis's Oakamoor Sand 2 or Grandcourt Sand 3, strain, temperature, loading, control composition and analytical fraction. Identify reused experiments rather than count publications as independent replication.
3. Reconstruct the reported percentage's numerator/denominator and distinguish reduction, acid-extractable Fe, dissolved Fe, bulk impurity removal and isolated-product recovery. Preserve unresolved contradictions.
4. If a clean thesis revision exists, retain both versions and document claim-bearing changes. Do not rewrite the originally inspected artifact or invent corrected numbering.
5. Update the maintained owner only where newly inspected evidence supports a change, with canonical EDIT history and a fresh independent review.

Bounded all-state duplicate check: the round84 initial inventory contained 280 issue/PR objects; exact source DOI, handle, Yahaya and silica/quartz-sand terms produced no match. Root should repeat the live duplicate check before posting. Detailed provenance is in `research/sources/round84-resources/20261015T000755Z-source-investigation.{md,json}`; raw originals remain outside Git.
disposition: Open source follow-up; current scoped evidence retained. No claim of resolved source uncertainty.

title: Resolve metavivianite protocol and biological phase-identification gaps
body:
# Resolve metavivianite protocol and biological phase-identification gaps

The qualified `data/records/metavivianite.yaml` record and `research/sources/round84-phosphates/20261015T001048Z-source-investigation.{md,json}` retain three unresolved source limitations. These are follow-up evidence requirements, not a claim that the current record proves microbial production of modern, phase-pure metavivianite.

1. **Chiba et al. 2020 sample temperature label.** DOI [10.2465/jmps.200417](https://doi.org/10.2465/jmps.200417), original p. 486 Methods, names a `viv-S65` sample after listing the 50, 60, 70 and 90 °C arms; Results/Figure 3/Table 2 use `viv-S60`. Seek an existing correction, public original protocol or data that resolves the 60/65 °C label. Do not silently choose one temperature. The accepted main paper identifies mixed metavivianite/vivianite/spheniscidite products, not a phase-specific yield.
2. **Erbs 2004 provisional microbial intermediate.** DOI [10.3929/ethz-a-004796330](https://doi.org/10.3929/ethz-a-004796330), Chapter 2, especially printed pp. 29–34 and Figures 2.5–2.8, reports spectroscopic observations in an unidentified nitrate-reducing enrichment. The thesis explicitly reports that poor crystallinity prevented XRD identification. Seek existing orthogonal phase-identification evidence or a properly characterized follow-up experiment before upgrading this observation to verified biological formation of the current IMA species. The 26% and 38% ferric spectral areas are not mineral-phase fractions, and the historical variable-formula assignment is not automatically the modern ideal formula.
3. **Miot et al. 2009 announced supplementary evidence.** DOI [10.1111/j.1472-4669.2009.00203.x](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1472-4669.2009.00203.x), Supporting Information `GBI_203_sm_FigS1-S2_Data S1.pdf` (Figures S1–S2/Data S1). Obtain and inspect a legitimate complete copy before extending the present main-text XRD counterexample to supplementary beam-damage, STEM or quantitative XAS-fit claims. The two documented publisher routes returned HTML access responses during this bounded investigation; this is not a general source-unavailability claim.

Acceptance requires a new dated source dossier with acquisition provenance, original file hashes, precise methods/figure/table locators, and an explicit disposition for each gap. Any supported record change must keep experimental lineages separate, preserve unresolved alternatives, append canonical history and receive an independent scientific review. If new evidence still does not resolve a gap, retain the limitation and leave that item open. No author contact or new experiment is authorized by this draft.

The retained all-state issue inventory was searched by mineral name and all three identifiers; no matching existing issue title/body was found. Exact inventory hash and search scope are retained in `/private/tmp/cmm-round84-metavivianite-source-followup-dedup.json`.
disposition: Open source follow-up; current scoped evidence retained. No claim of resolved source uncertainty.

title: Acquire Baldi 1987 original graphics and reassess the cinnabar-alone comparison
body:
# Acquire Baldi and Olson 1987 original graphics and reassess the cinnabar-alone comparison

Baldi F. and Olson G. J. (1987), *Effects of Cinnabar on Pyrite Oxidation by Thiobacillus ferrooxidans and Cinnabar Mobilization by a Mercury-Resistant Strain*, Applied and Environmental Microbiology 53(4):772–776. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1128/aem.53.4.772-776.1987; PMC203754.

This is a source-acquisition and comparison follow-up, not a demonstrated error in the accepted Jew2014 cinnabar record. The complete five-page institutional PDF was exposed through a web PDF text parser, but original graphics were not visually inspected. Direct acquisition of the Ca’ Foscari institutional route returned HTTP403 and the web screenshot route timed out. The ASM PDF endpoint returned403; the nominal PMC PDF returned HTTP200 HTML challenge content, not PDF. All these responses were retained with true type, size and digest. No challenge bypass or author contact was attempted.

A legitimate institutional route is https://iris.unive.it/retrieve/e4239ddc-0485-7180-e053-3705fe0a3322/aem00121-0164%20.pdf . The exact failed-response/acquisition and parsed-text access state are retained in the round84 sulfides source dossier and external acquisition manifests. Another unchanged denied request alone is not progress.

The parsed original Results appear to report detectable volatilized and dissolved mercury for washed SW9K1 with cinnabar and no added ferrous iron, whereas Jew et al.2014 (DOI10.1111/gbi.12066) summarize prior cinnabar-alone behavior more categorically. Conditions, strain, mercury endpoints and control recipes need direct original figure/table assessment before treating these as contradictory experiments. The apparent discrepancy is presently deferred; no numerical Baldi outcome has been added to the cinnabar owner.

Acceptance:

- Obtain a legitimate complete original or inspectable original-page rendition, retaining version, route, acquisition date, true format and SHA256. Read all methods/results, original tables and figures.
- Verify phase/purity characterization, strain SW9K1 and its historical/current taxonomic scope, biomass washing and any Fe or medium carryover; compare cinnabar-only, pyrite, ferrous-iron and relevant cell-free controls.
- Keep Hg0 trapping, dissolved/operational-filtered mercury and total-mass balance distinct. Determine actual replication, source units and denominators; do not infer isolated recovery or industrial deployment.
- Compare the exact Baldi results with Jew2014’s citation and isolate/consortium experiments without assuming identical controls or taxa. Record unresolved disagreement explicitly and independently review any supported owner EDIT.

Deduplication: the round84 all-state inventory of280 issue/PR entries was searched by names, DOI and cinnabar; no issue for this exact original or comparison was present. Hidden/ignored-inclusive followed searches of maintained research/reviews/history/records, original-main roots and bounded referenced raw folders found prior screened Baldi/Jew context, which is retained rather than claimed novel. Existing issue272 concerns a different HgSe/tiemannite source. This bounded search is not a global absence claim.
disposition: Open source follow-up; current scoped evidence retained. No claim of resolved source uncertainty.
